200300Z POSITION NEAR 16.2N 135.0E.
20OCT26. SUPER TYPHOON 29W (CHAMPI), LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 766 NM
SOUTH-SOUTHWEST OF CHICHI JIMA, HAS TRACKED WEST-NORTHWESTWARD AT
12 KNOTS OVER THE PAST SIX HOURS. MINIMUM CENTRAL PRESSURE AT 200000Z 
IS 929 MB. MAXIMUM SIGNIFICANT WAVE HEIGHT AT 200000Z IS 55 FEET. NEXT
